title: Contact cases: specialist clinic's booking letter (English)

pages.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FAKE DATA ONLY
Testville Orthopaedic Clinic (FAKE)
77 Placeholder Road, Suite 300, Testville ON Z9Z 9Z5 · Tel 613-555-0190 · Fax 613-555-0191

6 November 2026

Mx. Jordan FAKE-Ellis
Phone on file: 613-555-0163
Referral no.: RF-0099-4412            Health card: 9123 456 789 (FAKE)

Dear Mx. FAKE-Ellis,

We have received your referral from Dr. Casey FAKE-Okoro (Maplewood Test Family Health Team,
Tel 613-555-0142, Fax 613-555-0143).

Reason for referral: right knee pain for 4 months. The MRI of 12 October 2026 suggests a possible
tear of the medial meniscus.

Your appointment is on Friday 20 November 2026 at 9:15 a.m. with Dr. Riley FAKE-Mendes,
orthopaedic surgeon. The clinic is at 77 Placeholder Road, Suite 300, Testville. Please arrive
15 minutes early.

Please bring your health card and a list of your medicines. Wear shorts or loose trousers so the
knee can be examined.

If you cannot come, call 613-555-0190 at least 48 hours before, so that another patient can have
the time.

Booking office, Testville Orthopaedic Clinic (FAKE)
